tables.how: Every resolution or ordinance about a contract, grant or agreement the City pays for, introduced from January 2014 to 12 November 2026, whose title gives an amount before the file of under $10,000,000 and an amount after it of $10,000,000 or more: 249 files. 2 emergency declarations and other files whose title names no other party are left out, leaving 247. 148 of the 247 agreements stood at $9.5 million or more before the file and 76 at $9.9 million or more. 230 files passed; the rest were pending, filed or with the Mayor when the records were retrieved. Acceptances of outside grants, settlements, loans and agreements that pay the City are left out.
tables.limits: Amounts and names are read by rule from each file's title; the link opens the file itself, which governs. A title shows the latest version of the legislation, and a file that states no earlier amount cannot appear here. This is the Board seeing an agreement for the first time after a department had signed it alone, which the Charter allows below $10 million. It is not a finding that any first amount was set to avoid a vote: a contract can outgrow its first estimate, an emergency contract can be extended, and a one-year contract can be renewed. An agreement that was raised past the line with the earlier amount left out of the title is missing.

tables.limits: An increase a department made on its own authority, below the level that needs a vote, leaves no Board file and so no row here: the only trace is the amount before in the next Board file. A row is a public record of an approval or an amount, not a finding: every increase past $10 million listed here went to the Board, and those acted on were approved.
